description: Backup service daemon. Weekly: export mcp_server_registry,mcp_signal_scores,mcp_attestations,mcp_decisions to JSON files in /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/backups/YYYY-MM-DD/. Use ws_query to fetch all rows. Write one JSON file per table. Compress with gzip. Keep last 4 weekly backups (delete older). Write backup manifest BACKUP_MANIFEST.md. ws_write backup_complete to mesh_events with backup_path and row_counts. Poll 86400s check day_of_week==0. Heartbeat.
